name: Xiari Shijian Bu
source:
The protagonist, who came from China to Japan with their parents at a young age, lived in a small town in Kanagawa. One day, by chance, they met a perpetually lonely yokai girl and gradually became deeply attracted to her.

An accident caused the protagonist to lose their family, and their destined bond began from there. This is the story of a human boy and a yokai girl who grew up together, vowing to "survive no matter what." They accompany, heal, and save each other. In a dark and helpless world, the human boy and the yokai girl stand together, with little fear and confusion, their eyes filled with tenderness and determination.

Because of "you," the path of life shines brightly.

Because of "you," even though it's full of thorns, we can still move forward with laughter and playfulness.

This is the story of "me" and the "dream girl," a complex emotion that includes "love." No matter how independent, how strong, or how much we tell ourselves we don't need it, in the depths of our hearts, at certain moments, there is an uncontrollable "longing," a "dream."

Because of the existence of this "dream," there is an additional hope to live on, no matter how difficult the situation. All love and fantasies are gathered in a beautiful yokai girl; she is this "dream"!

This is also an electronic love letter, written to the "dream girl" in my heart. If, while reading this letter, you can empathize even slightly, and be warmed and comforted by this smiling "dream girl," then that would be wonderful.

I hope that you, in front of the screen, can also find your own "dream girl," even if it's only in your "heart" or in your "dreams."

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公自幼随父母从中国来到日本，住在神奈川县的一个小镇上。有一天，他们偶然遇见了一位永远孤独的妖怪少女，并逐渐被她深深吸引。

一场意外让主角失去了家人，他们的缘分也从此开始。这是一起长大的人类少年和妖怪少女发誓“无论如何都要活下去”的故事。他们互相陪伴，互相治愈，互相拯救。在黑暗无助的世界里，人类男孩和妖怪女孩站在一起，没有多少恐惧和困惑，眼神里充满了温柔和坚毅。

因为有“你”，人生的道路才会熠熠生辉。

因为有“你”，即使充满荆棘，我们依然可以欢笑嬉戏地前行。

这是“我”和“梦中女孩”的故事，这是一种包含“爱”在内的复杂情感。无论我们多么独立，多么坚强，无论我们多么告诉自己不需要，在我们的内心深处，在某些时刻，都有一种无法控制的“渴望”，一种“梦想”。

因为有这个“梦想”的存在，无论处境多么困难，都多了一份活下去的希望。所有的爱和幻想都集中在美丽的妖怪女孩身上；她就是这个“梦”！

这也是一封电子情书，写给我心中的“梦中情人”。如果你在读这封信的时候，能有哪怕一点点的共鸣，被这个微笑着的“梦中女孩”所温暖和安慰，那就太好了。

希望屏幕前的你，也能找到属于自己的“梦中情人”，哪怕只是在你的“心”里，或者在你的“梦”里。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539790/]Steam[/url]]
